headline: Care without a scheduled *appointment*.
lede: For select conditions, you may be able to receive care without a scheduled video visit — on your time, without sitting in a waiting room.
intro: Complete a secure online questionnaire about your symptoms and medical history. Your provider will review the information and determine whether your concern can be safely treated through an e-visit.

groups.title: How it works
items: Start your e-visit in our secure patient portal
Answer questions about your symptoms and history
Your provider reviews during office hours
You receive a plan, or a recommendation for the right next step

groups.title: Good fit for
items: Situations that don't need real-time conversation
Follow-up questions on an established plan

groups.title: Choose a video visit instead for
items: New concerns that benefit from discussion

clinicalNote: E-visits are available for select uncomplicated concerns. Submission of a questionnaire does not guarantee treatment, a diagnosis, or a prescription. A prescription is provided only when medically appropriate. Some conditions require a video visit, an in-person examination, testing, or a higher level of care. Controlled substances are not prescribed.
emergencyNotice: If you are experiencing a medical emergency or potentially life-threatening symptoms, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not use the website, patient portal, messaging system, or an online visit to seek emergency care.
